低價黑區射擊遊戲的爆紅風潮

刻板印象與種族歧視的爭議漩渦

爭端迅速波及實況社群，美國知名實況團體 AMP 成員 DKThannis 公開斥責遊戲設定陳腐且缺乏文化真實性，知名黑人創作團隊 RDCWorld 更在直播時遭到觀眾聊天室嚴厲指責，最終無奈放棄遊玩。與此同時，另一派實況主與玩家則認為這只是單純的黑色幽默與諷刺娛樂，實況主 LY 便反駁指出，若描寫現實暴力的遊戲就該被譴責，那麼玩家是否也該抵制《決勝時刻》或《俠盜獵車手》等主流商業巨作，使這場關於電玩創作尺度的論戰持續延燒。

criticism on Twitter, "YourRAGE" subsequently emphasized quite arrogantly that it was just a joke, and criticized people on Twitter for being too stupid, needing an explanation every time he makes a joke. Do I have to say I'm joking after I say a joke? For it to be a joke? Doesn't that ruin the [ __ ]? As the war in the chat continued to heat up, they gradually lost the mood and eventually had to give up on playing the game. >> In contrast, another AMP member, Fanum, streamed himself having a great time playing the game, leading players to joke that while everyone else was getting furious, he was having the time of his life. Finally, Kai emphasized that what's truly stupid isn't a game making fun of gang culture , but the fact that people in reality are still killing each other over turf or gang colors to this day. Like. genuinely, if you get offended by a depiction of people who choose to kill each other over a block that they rent to live on, then you are a [ __ ]. Because gang culture in itself is moronic. And it's also hypocritical from the fake offended people because you play GTA, listen to rap music that does nothing but glorify the detriment of our community. You mother—sit up here.

and watch—sit there and watch a bunch of ignorant ass fight and yell at each other but then going to sit here and have the nerve to say the way people are trying to make money off of our struggle. What struggle? >> Other players also remarked that they are more outraged by a game than they are by actual gang violence in reality. However, players against Hood Warfare 2 have countered this, arguing that while GTA makes fun of various ideas and cultures, Hood Warfare 2 focuses almost exclusively on stereotypes of Black gang violence, so they cannot be. directly compared. I wonder how the players view this? 摘要

實體遊戲的消逝與天價「無遊戲」收藏盒

作者首先回憶起過往玩家排隊購買實體光碟與珍藏版的熱血年代，對比現今數位預載普及，遊戲廠商卻逐漸取消實體光碟的現狀。更令人傻眼的是，Rockstar 為備受期待的《俠盜獵車手 6》（GTA 6）推出了要價近 400 美元的「收藏盒」，內部雖附贈聯名墨鏡、帽子與鱷魚雕像，卻完全不包含遊戲本體，引發玩家群體的強烈不滿與嘲諷，痛批遊戲公司過度貪婪。

駭客捲土重來：全裸外流畫面引發熱議

回歸純單人恐怖體驗與發售初期的出貨風波
